        Join us

        At Start.io (formerly StartApp) we are looking for talented, passionate people who want to help us shape the future of decision making in business. Together, we can build success for our customers and partners, for Start.io as a company, and for your professional career and personal aspirations.

        Our People
        You

        Humble, forward-thinking, self-taught, curious, creative, and open-minded

        We

        A team of individual talents & personalities, working as one for a common purpose

        Our goals

        Try bold new ideas and set ambitious quantified targets

        Winning

        Move fast, take ownership and make an impact

        Our Perks

        Start.io is proud to be a globally distributed, remote-friendly team. We offer our employees benefits and perks that support their health and wellness, and personal growth.

        Work-Life Balance
        We want you at your best, and that means growing and investing in yourself while boosting your career.
        Transparent Culture
        We keep things open and accessible so we can make better decisions together, faster.
        Plan Ahead
        We offer retirement savings and investment plans [401(k)].
        Be Part of a Team
        Team & department lunches, happy hours, networking & bonding.
        Remote Friendly
        Our team is located all over the world, and we support remote and in-person work.
        6th Year Sabbatical
        Yes – you deserve a month off (fully paid) after all your hard work!
        Healthcare is First and Foremost
        Happy and healthy go together. We got you covered with comprehensive healthcare and a wellness stipend.

        This website uses cookies to improve your experience while you navigate through the website.
